text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumoude♪ Hatsumoude♪
Off to the shrine for New Year's Day~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Drink amazake, eat grilled squid~...
And then, and then, gotta drink some cold water too!
choice_data_list: Cold water?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you didn't know that, Trainer?
There's super-duper cold water at the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"There are cups too, you know—!
The handles are super long and awkward to use, though!"
choice_data_list: Don't drink that water...
You shouldn't drink that water...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, really~!?
Even though it's so cold~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Let's write down our wishes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I have so many wishes I want to ask for!
Like, "I want to run in the Arima Kinen" for starters!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And also, "I want to eat delicious carrots"!
"I want to get lots of 1st places"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna get super fast," "I wanna get strong,"
"I wanna do lots of fun things," and then—
choice_data_list: How about we stick to writing just one?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, just one~?
I can't choose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What would you write if you were the Trainer?

Haru Urara now holds the grand ambition
of 'running in the Arima Kinen.'
In that case, what I should write is...
choice_data_list: Health comes first! "May you run full of energy!"
Boost your overall ability! 'Level Up'
Refine technique! "Become an Expert"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Health comes first!
You can't run if you're not feeling good!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm always running full of energy!
You mean even more, way more?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho...
Wait, no—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ura-ura-ura-ura-ura-ura~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, this is so fun!
I'm gonna run all carefree and sunny!

It felt a little off the mark,
but Haru Urara seemed ready to become even more energetic.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Level up!!
Feels like I can get way stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I know how to level up!
I saw it on TV!"
choice_data_list: Will you show me?
Will you show me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Da-da-da-da-da-daaa!
Haru Urara leveled up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm-hmm, I kind of feel like I've gotten stronger!
All right, time to keep leveling up like this!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Da-da-da-da-da-daaa!
Da-da-da-da-da-daaa!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waah, I'm getting stronger and stronger!
Or at least, it feels like it~!!
"...Perhaps self-hypnosis is effective in its own way. I'll refrain from saying anything..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, an expert...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, what does that mean?
choice_data_list: That means you're a true professional in your field.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm? What kind of path?
What am I supposed to become a pro in?
choice_data_list: If it's Urara, it'd have to be the path of running.
If it's Urara, it'd have to be the path of running.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!!
The way of running...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I will!
I'm gonna become a pro of the racing path!

Haru Urara is raring to go.
I'm sure she'll hone a technique all her own.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I made my wish!
choice_data_list: Well then, time to head back and train.
Well then, time to head back and train!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!
Training already?
choice_data_list: No good?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love running, buuut~
Look, there are so many food stalls!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So hang out with me
a little bit longer~!
choice_data_list: You want to run in the "Arima Kinen", don't you?
You want to run in the "Arima Kinen", right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh, I don't get it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why do we have to train right away
if we're entering the Arima Kinen?
choice_data_list: You won't win unless you take this more seriously!
You won't win unless you take this more seriously.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was serious the whole time!
I've always been running with everything I've got, you know?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I went all out
until I literally dropped!"

...I couldn't help but hold my head in my hands.
As expected, Haru Urara considers the Arima Kinen to be just like any ordinary race.
Until now, simply 'having fun' was enough, but from here on, we'll need to focus on results and take on graded stakes races.

Keeping an eye on her aptitude and timing,
how can I teach her the mindset needed to run in graded races—?
choice_data_list: Urara, do you want to run the Negishi Stakes?
Urara, do you want to run the Negishi Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure thing~!
choice_data_list: Instant answer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I just love running so, so much!
Hey, hey, can I do a big loop around the shrine now?
"...Can I take the fact that they've started listening to meas a sign of growth, I wonder?"

In any case,
her next target race was decided
to be the Negishi Stakes!
